needs.what: an activated-ability flag meaning the ability may be activated only once for as long as this object exists (702.177: each exhaust ability only once), tracked per object and per ability, reset only when the permanent becomes a new object
needs.why_existing_wont_do: ability_keys carry once_each_turn, activate_steps and sorcery_speed_only, all of which reset each turn or restrict timing; nothing limits an activation to once per object lifetime, and the cost (pay_energy) and effects (add_counters, draw with extreme_value/max power) are otherwise expressible, so only the limit is missing
